senses.gloss: f. (preced.; cmp. חִיזְקָא) clasp, ring, signet-ring.
units: Targ. Ex. XXVIII, 11 (O. ed. Vien. עִזְקָן pl.).
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 38:18">Targ. O. Gen. XXXVIII, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 68a:10">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ דחקיק עלה שם</he> a ring on which the divine name was engraven; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45</cite>.

Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ top חד ע׳ צר a ring on which was a figure (Bub. ib. 43ᵃ טבעת ועליה צורת דרקין); a. fr.—[Lev. R. s. 13 כעזקתא סומקתא, read: כעַרְקְתָא.]—Trnsf. (v. טַבַּעַת) anus, end of the rectum.
Koh. R., to VII, 19; Yalk. ib. 976.—Pl. עִזְקיָּא, עִיזְ׳; עִזְקָתָא, עִזְקָן; עִי׳.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 25:12">Targ. Ex. XXV, 12</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 25:14">14</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:4:3">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>וטבעת</he> <cite ref="Numbers 31:50">Num. XXXI, 50</cite>).
